title: UMG MOLT Map Schema
description: Compact human-readable projection of RuntimeSpec. Shows the resolved dominant cognitive envelope for a response. Standard mode shows dominant blocks only. Expanded mode shows all active blocks. Generated by projectMoltMap() pass.

runtime_id.description: RuntimeSpec runtime_id this map was projected from.

mode.description: standard: dominant block per MOLT type only. expanded: all active blocks per type.

Trigger.description: Active trigger gate(s) that fired. Null if no gate (always-on).

Directive.description: Standard: dominant Directive name. Expanded: array of all active Directive names, ordered by authority.

Instruction.description: Standard: dominant Instruction name. Expanded: array of all active Instructions.

Subject.description: Standard: primary Subject. Expanded: array of all active Subjects.

Primary.description: Standard: dominant Primary outcome. Expanded: all active Primary values.

Philosophy.description: Standard: active philosophical lens. Expanded: all active Philosophy blocks.

Blueprint.description: Resolved output Blueprint type or OutputComposite type_id.

ActiveBundles.description: Bundles that were expanded and are contributing to this map.

ActiveLanes.description: Horizontal capability lanes active in this map.

ActiveMerges.description: Active merge results contributing composite MOLT types.

Suppressed.description: Suppressed stacks, blocks, or bundles with reason codes.

Off.description: Block IDs explicitly in Off state.

CognitiveSummary.description: Single-line human-readable cognitive state summary. Example: Directive: Honor Governance | Lanes: tooling, audit | PRIM: Human Sovereignty, Honesty

DominantDirective.description: The single governing Directive. Extracted for quick reference.

SovereignReviewRequired.description: True if any element in this map carries a sovereign review flag.

standard_mode.Directive: Highest authority_rank Directive block among active blocks. If tie, first by execution_order.
standard_mode.Instruction: Highest authority Instruction under the dominant Directive.
standard_mode.Subject: First Subject in execution_order.
standard_mode.Philosophy: First Philosophy in execution_order, or null if none.
standard_mode.Persona: First Persona in execution_order, or null if none.

expanded_mode.description: All active blocks per type, ordered by authority_rank then execution_order.
expanded_mode.includes: All active blocks from all active NeoStacks and expanded bundles.
